cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: But now we have to check one last thing, because you know, maybe we got lucky on this single test set.
cues.zh: 但還要確認最後一件事，因為也許單一測試集只是運氣好。

cues.en: Maybe that single test set was more favorable to XGBoost than the other classification models which could explain why XGBoost was number one.
cues.zh: 也許這個測試集更有利於 XGBoost，所以它才贏過其他模型、成為第一。

cues.en: And the only way to check this is by actually computing other accuracies on other test sets.
cues.zh: 要確認，就需要計算其他測試資料上的準確率。

cues.en: And this is exactly what k-fold Cross-Validation is about and that is why this is the last cell of this implementation.
cues.zh: 這正是 k 折交叉驗證的作用，所以它放在最後。

cues.en: And we also have the result for this, which is, as we can see, still an amazing accuracy of 96.53%.
cues.zh: 結果也出來了，仍然是很好的準確率，96.53%。

cues.en: This is, of course, an average accuracy obtained as a result of the average of 10 different accuracies measured on 10 different test sets, and besides, we have a rather small standard deviation
cues.zh: 這當然是 10 個不同驗證資料上、10 個準確率的平均，而且標準差相當小，

cues.en: of only 2%, which is good once again for this sensitive problem of cancer prediction.
cues.zh: 只有 2%，對癌症預測這種敏感問題而言，也是不錯的結果。

cues.en: So yes, XGBoost is definitely number one here and that's why my friends, I'm just super happy that we end on this good note with this final powerful tool
cues.zh: 所以這裡 XGBoost 確實第一。我很開心，以這個強大工具的好結果收尾，

cues.en: that you get in your machine learning toolkit because now you can start your post machine learning journey, you know, for your career, in full confidence and about that, that will be my final words to you
cues.zh: 把它放進機器學習工具箱，之後就能有信心展開課後的職涯旅程。關於這點，最後想對你說，

cues.en: in this course.
cues.zh: 也就是這門原課程的最後幾句話。

cues.en: I wish you tons of great success in your future machine learning projects.
cues.zh: 祝你未來的機器學習專案大獲成功。

cues.en: I wish that you are the talented data scientist who brings the strongest insight and the highest value analysis to your team and to your clients.
cues.zh: 希望你成為有才華的資料科學家，為團隊與客戶帶來最深入的洞見，以及最有價值的分析。

cues.en: Now you're totally able to do this thanks to your complete and powerful machine learning toolkit.
cues.zh: 現在有完整而強大的機器學習工具箱，你已能做到。

cues.en: With these you're totally able to smash your future machine learning problems.
cues.zh: 透過這些工具，能解決未來的機器學習問題。

cues.en: So once again, I wish you the best and I look forward to seeing you in another course for a new data science journey, and until then, of course, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 再次祝一切順利，期待在另一門課展開新的資料科學旅程。在那之前，當然，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
